articles.author: Surfer
articles.description:
RT Jean-François Gariépy 🧬
The consequences of this "demographic collapse":
> More accessibility to the real estate market for families.
> More space for everyone to enjoy.
> Reconcentration of societal developments around quality rather than quantity.
> Increased selectivity of natural selection processes, thus increasing the general quality of the gene pool.
> Reduction of human footprint and easing off of human destructivity over all ecological niches.
It's time we stop letting the alarmists change the language around regular population phenomena. It's not a demographic collapse, it's a possible future reduction of the population. It makes absolutely ZERO SENSE to expect human populations to always be growing.
People like Elon must stop. You're asking for infinite growth in a finite world. Let nature settle this. Just make sure you don't import billions of immigrants as you let her do her thing.
